questions.stem: A 32-year-old pregnant woman at 10 weeks gestation presents to the antenatal clinic for her routine prenatal visit. She reports a recent rash that started three days ago, starting from her face and spreading to her trunk and limbs. She mentions that she has never been vaccinated against rubella and has no history of prior infection. On examination, her temperature is 38.5°C (101.3°F), and she has a generalized maculopapular rash. Laboratory tests reveal a positive rubella IgM antibody. What is the most appropriate management option for this patient?

options.label: D
options.text: "Counseling regarding the potential risks in continuation of pregnancy"
